info.title: pkgsilo API
info.description: The HTTP API of pkgsilo. Responses are JSON, in a resource or collection envelope, and problems are RFC 9457 Problem Details. Policies decide what the caller may do: an object that the caller may not read is answered like a missing one, and fields that it may not read are absent.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: The health of pkgsilo, for load balancers and monitoring. It needs no authentication.

tags.name: Identities
tags.description: An identity is a user of pkgsilo, a person or an agent, with a unique username and a display name. It authenticates with API keys, and the policies decide what it may do. Fields that the policies don't allow the caller to read are absent from a response.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: An API key authenticates requests as the identity that it belongs to, in the X-API-Key header. Its key is returned only once, when it's created. Fields that the policies don't allow the caller to read are absent from a response.

tags.name: Passwords
tags.description: An identity can have one password, besides its API keys. No response holds a password or its hash. Fields that the policies don't allow the caller to read are absent from a response.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: A group is a named set of identities, its members, which policies can apply to all at once. Fields that the policies don't allow the caller to read are absent from a response.

tags.name: Policies
tags.description: A policy holds Cedar statements that permit or forbid identities and groups actions on the resources of pkgsilo. Whatever no policy permits is denied. Fields that the policies don't allow the caller to read are absent from a response.

get.description: Lists the groups that the caller may read, oldest first. The others are left out, as if they didn't exist.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details object. Its type tells problems apart, and other members than those below may extend it.

username.description: The unique name of the identity: 3 to 64 lowercase letters and digits, optionally separated by single '.', '_' or '-', such as ada.lovelace.

displayName.description: The human-readable name of the identity, such as Ada Lovelace: 1 to 128 characters, without line breaks.

newPassword.description: The new password. It must not be empty; there are no other rules, and it's used exactly as sent.

currentPassword.description: The password that the new one replaces. Required unless the policies allow the caller to reset the password, in which case it's ignored.

apiKey.description: An API key of an identity, which the request acts as.
apiKey.name: X-API-Key
